# Lists

## Inherited bullets and decimal delimiters

```````````````````````````````` example
- a
+ b
* c

3. d
4. e

1) f

0. z
.
Document scope=1:1..10:4 children=6
├── List scope=1:1..1:3 flavor=bullet start=null style=null delimiter=null tight=true children=1
│   └── ListItem scope=1:1..1:3 marker=null exampleLabel=null children=1
│       └── Paragraph scope=1:3..1:3 children=1
│           └── Text scope=1:3..1:3 literal="a" children=0
├── List scope=2:1..2:3 flavor=bullet start=null style=null delimiter=null tight=true children=1
│   └── ListItem scope=2:1..2:3 marker=null exampleLabel=null children=1
│       └── Paragraph scope=2:3..2:3 children=1
│           └── Text scope=2:3..2:3 literal="b" children=0
├── List scope=3:1..4:0 flavor=bullet start=null style=null delimiter=null tight=true children=1
│   └── ListItem scope=3:1..4:0 marker=null exampleLabel=null children=1
│       └── Paragraph scope=3:3..3:3 children=1
│           └── Text scope=3:3..3:3 literal="c" children=0
├── List scope=5:1..7:0 flavor=ordered start=3 style=decimal delimiter=period tight=true children=2
│   ├── ListItem scope=5:1..5:4 marker=null exampleLabel=null children=1
│   │   └── Paragraph scope=5:4..5:4 children=1
│   │       └── Text scope=5:4..5:4 literal="d" children=0
│   └── ListItem scope=6:1..7:0 marker=null exampleLabel=null children=1
│       └── Paragraph scope=6:4..6:4 children=1
│           └── Text scope=6:4..6:4 literal="e" children=0
├── List scope=8:1..9:0 flavor=ordered start=1 style=decimal delimiter=oneParen tight=true children=1
│   └── ListItem scope=8:1..9:0 marker=null exampleLabel=null children=1
│       └── Paragraph scope=8:4..8:4 children=1
│           └── Text scope=8:4..8:4 literal="f" children=0
└── List scope=10:1..10:4 flavor=ordered start=0 style=decimal delimiter=period tight=true children=1
    └── ListItem scope=10:1..10:4 marker=null exampleLabel=null children=1
        └── Paragraph scope=10:4..10:4 children=1
            └── Text scope=10:4..10:4 literal="z" children=0
````````````````````````````````

## The inherited decimal ceiling

```````````````````````````````` example
123456789. nine

1234567890. ten
.
Document scope=1:1..3:15 children=2
├── List scope=1:1..2:0 flavor=ordered start=123456789 style=decimal delimiter=period tight=true children=1
│   └── ListItem scope=1:1..2:0 marker=null exampleLabel=null children=1
│       └── Paragraph scope=1:12..1:15 children=1
│           └── Text scope=1:12..1:15 literal="nine" children=0
└── Paragraph scope=3:1..3:15 children=1
    └── Text scope=3:1..3:15 literal="1234567890. ten" children=0
````````````````````````````````
